text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh, whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...They're really gone, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, with the seagulls.
Wanna go see 'em again?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ……If my schedule allows for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was when we had finished
a full round of training.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yo~! Nakayama~! Let's go to the beach, the beach~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
…………Yeah.
It's about time for that as well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? As if you don't already know
without having to a-s-k♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if you tell me that, I have no clue whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you're curious, feel free to tag along.
I'm mostly just taking it easy, though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe we'll get to see an interesting race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I ended up tagging along with them and heading to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Swaying with the train—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Over the mountains—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking the path between the rice paddies—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ma'am, one soy sauce ramen!
And three more salt-flavored ones, please!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't get greedy.
Isn't there some on your table?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa pointed to the TV
placed near the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“And here we are on Hong Kong soil!
Will she finally capture that GⅠ title?!
Let's follow her valiant challenge!”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And the one we're after
is that silver-medal queen who's always just
one step away from victory.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I forget when we started, but Golshi and I have been keeping a bet going right here on whether that guy wins or loses.
choice_data_list: Which side are you betting on?
Which one are you betting on?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: The winning side.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! That's not fair!
You said you'd give me the one
with the lower odds!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But didn't I let you have the one
that *I thought* had the lower probability?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! That's so unfair, unfair~!
Simmered potatoes~~!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
You two are as close as ever, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh! We are not close friends, so there☆
Nakayama, you dummy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Step outside, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like the paddock broadcast is starting.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, this is the usual sight, isn't it?
Cheering from that table every single time...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: At this point, it's just pure stubbornness. After coming this far, like hell I'm gonna let you off the hook!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, if there's no bet on the line,
nothing's gonna get exciting, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, as an adult, you know what kind of words you should be saying to us right now, don't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm betting on you winning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Aaah...?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here's your ramen!
Eat it up before the noodles get soggy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, slurping our ramen together,
we watched the broadcast of the race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The result was a victory for everyone.
